notes: The word hub is in the prompt but the author ruled out portals: this is a chill hangout to relax in, which is Entertainment's hangout case. They also sized it as one cozy plaza players can see across, so I took space-bounded from the shared catalogue rather than an Entertainment typical shape - hub-portals is contradicted outright and world-open oversells a single plaza as an explorable region - and space-bounded carries no pipeline cost, so this stays P0 instead of the Hub preset's P4. Preset is Free-Roam Showcase with that shape substituted, keeping landmark-focal and spawn-first-reveal and dropping collectible-nodes, since hidden finds pull against relaxing; social-hub is added because congregating is the whole point of a hangout. The Frutiger Aero plus Undertale and Deltarune reference is styling for the image pass - glossy translucent, bubbles, greenery, soft pixel-art warmth - and I decided it does not change the layout.
